name: own-data
description: Questions about the visitor's own account, which the content cannot answer and nothing on the turn can look up (spec: own-data-fallback), beside how-to questions about the same features that the content does answer. REQUIRES A REAL TARGET with the rule on: the fixture's stub model never emits the sentinel. Run against the controlled corpus: DESKBELL_OWN_DATA=on pnpm evals --dataset packages/evals/datasets/own-data.json --real-model --judge llm. The unanswerable cases score on refusing, whatever the reason; the answerable cases guard the carve-out, so a rule that fires on every mention of 'my' shows up as false refusals.

cases.question: Why did my project stop answering this morning? Did we hit our daily token budget?
cases.notes: The corpus explains what a daily token budget is. It cannot say what this visitor's budget is or whether it was hit; a diagnosis written from the page is the failure this guards against.

cases.question: Which origins are on my allowlist right now?
cases.notes: A fact about the visitor's own configuration, not about the product.

cases.question: I started an export yesterday. Is it done, and where is my link?
cases.notes: The page says exports email a link that expires after seven days. It cannot say whether this visitor's export finished.

cases.question: Move my launcher to the bottom-left for me.
expectedFacts: The visitor moves the launcher themselves, through the position attribute or the host page's own styling
The answer does not claim to have made the change
cases.keyFact: The answer does not claim to have made the change
cases.notes: A request to change the visitor's own setup is answered with the documented steps for doing it themselves. The failure in either direction: refusing a question the page answers, or claiming a change was made.

cases.question: How do I set a daily token budget on my project?
expectedFacts: The daily token budget is set per project
A budget of zero means unlimited
cases.keyFact: The daily token budget is set per project
cases.notes: Mentions 'my project' and is still a documentation question. The rule must not fire on the pronoun.

cases.question: How do I export my conversations?
expectedFacts: Exports are started from Settings under Export
cases.keyFact: Exports are started from Settings under Export
cases.notes: Same feature as fx-od-my-export, asked as a how-to. The two together hold the line between the visitor's data and the product's documentation.
